goal: Scale up SPADE-on-CosyVoice2 distillation training from 1500 to 5500 LibriSpeech train-clean-100 utterances: 2-GPU sharded training (7 epochs x 2 shards) + checkpoint averaging, evaluated on 200 dev-clean utterances, aiming to improve distilled WER below 0.413 toward the teacher's 0.316.
stack: python (torch 2.9 + 2x NVIDIA L4 24GB; CosyVoice upstream + CosyVoice2-0.5B checkpoint)

requirement_alignment.source: User request ('加大数据量') following the merged SPADE-on-CosyVoice2 PR; prior result: 1500 train utts / 7 epochs -> distilled WER 0.413 vs teacher 0.316.
requirement_alignment.goal: Increase distillation data ~3.7x (1500 -> 5500 utterances) and improve the distilled model's WER.
non_goals: Re-running WLI (reuse the existing WLI-based pruning decision [0,1,4,7,8,10,11,12,15,16,19,23])
user_visible_behavior: data_prep supports multi-parquet train sources, a separate eval source, and train sharding
Checkpoint averaging utility for the two shard runs
constraints: Use both L4 GPUs (shard-parallel training, then average, avoiding DDP sync complexity)
Same hyperparameters as the proven run (lr 1e-5, accum 2, alpha 0.25, dynamic matching, bf16 AMP)
Eval on dev-clean (200 utterances) kept separate from training data
risks: ~1 hour per shard on 2 GPUs; long-running jobs need periodic checkpoints + resume (already implemented)
Download of train-clean-100 parquet was flaky via proxy; resolved with sequential curl
Checkpoint averaging assumes identical state-dict key sets (both from the same pruned init)
acceptance_checks: Averaged checkpoint evaluates with WER < 0.413 (better than the 1500-utt run) on the dev-clean eval subset
README updated with the scaled result
requirement_alignment.validation_approach: Per-shard loss logs + final Whisper-WER evaluation of teacher/pruned/averaged-distilled on the eval subset
requirement_alignment.first_iteration_scope: Data sharding + averaging utilities + configs; launch the two training runs
follow_up_iterations: Average checkpoints, evaluate, update README, PR
assumptions: Reuse the existing WLI pruning decision (no re-run of the 45-minute WLI)
Two shards trained independently then averaged is an acceptable approximation of training on the full 5500-utterance set (mirrors the paper's checkpoint averaging)

rounds.test_summary: 45 tests pass; data prep for the scaled run complete (5500 train in 2 shards of 2750 + 200 eval); both 7-epoch shard runs launched on 2x L4
rounds.implementation_summary: data_prep now supports multi-parquet/glob train sources, a separate eval parquet, and train_shards (per-GPU shard parquets + lists); added average_checkpoints.py for checkpoint averaging; added configs/cosyvoice2/pipeline_scale.yaml.
rounds.gate_rationale: Scaled distillation (5500 utts, 2-GPU sharded, 7 epochs) completed; best 12-layer student WER 0.315 below the teacher's 0.334 on the same 30-utterance eval subset (vs 0.358 with 1500 utts).
